text: Chromatopsia [Gr. crwma , colour, + oyiV , vision]: Ger. Chromatopsie ; Fr. sensation anormale de couleur ; Ital. cromatopsia . An abnormal colour sensation; such as the yellow appearance of objects after a dose of santonin; also called Chromopsia, Chroöpsia. See VISION (defects of). ( J.J. )
